title: Stonesaga Campaign Journal
summary: A companion app for Stonesaga — track crafting discoveries, behemoths, challenges, culture, cave-wall art, and campaign history.
description: A table-friendly web app for the Stonesaga board game. Records crafted item recipes and dead-end codes, explores material combinations using token pip data (with inferred combinations from pip equivalence), and keeps a full campaign journal: tribe culture, behemoths, challenge record by epoch, looming challenges, investigations, notes, and a cave-wall gallery drawn in the app with the six game-box pencils. The whole group shares one journal via Google Drive sync with newest-wins merging, per-conflict review, and undo for deletions. Works on phones and tablets.
